_meta.description: Single source of truth for all ROS↔Unity topics. Use this file to configure both the ROS node and the Unity ROS-TCP-Connector. All topic names, message types, directions, and field schemas are defined here.

topics.description: Main teleop command. Unity publishes 4 joint angles (rad) every frame. ROS receives, validates, runs Kalman filter, and sends to robot.

header.stamp: RosTime — current Unity timestamp (used for latency calculation)

name: joint1
joint2
joint3
joint4
fields.position: float64[4] — joint angles in RADIANS. Order: [J1, J2, J3, J4]

topics.notes: Angles must be within robot limits: J1 ±160°, J2 ±90°, J3 -175°~0°, J4 ±160°. Validated on ROS side automatically.

topics.description: Actual robot joint state (9 joints including passive/mimic joints for URDF visualization). Published at 125Hz from feedback packet byte offset 432.

header.stamp: RosTime — hardware timestamp from feedback packet

name: joint1
joint2
joint2_2
joint3
joint3_2
joint4
joint4_1
joint4_2
joint4_2_end
fields.position: float64[9] — joint angles in RADIANS. Active joints at index 0,1,3,8.

topics.notes: For UI display of J1-J4, read indices 0,1,3,8 and convert rad→deg.

topics.description: End-effector TCP position reported by robot firmware (includes active tool offset). From binary feedback packet offset 624. Updated at 20Hz.

fields.data: float64[6] — [x_mm, y_mm, z_mm, rx_deg, ry_deg, rz_deg]

topics.notes: For MG400, ry=rz=0 always. rx = J1+J4 (wrist orientation). This value includes tool offset configured in Dobot Studio.

topics.description: End-effector TCP target position from firmware (firmware's own target, not Unity input). From feedback packet offset 768.

fields.data: float64[6] — [x_mm, y_mm, z_mm, rx_deg, ry_deg, rz_deg]

topics.description: Flange (J4 tip) XYZ computed via FK from actual joint angles. Does NOT include tool offset. Use this to compare with Unity FK — difference = latency/control error only.
FK result of the Unity joint input (what XYZ Unity is targeting). Computed from q_safe in _unity_callback using MG400 kinematics. No tool offset included.
Output of the Kalman filter + target predictor. The smoothed/predicted joint target the ROS controller actually uses before sending to robot.

fields.position: float64[4] — [J1, J2, J3, J4] in RADIANS

topics.description: The actual command sent to the robot after proximity gating. Used for staircase visualization — only updates when command actually changes.

fields.position: float64[4] — [J1, J2, J3, J4] in RADIANS

topics.description: Currently active tool index on the robot (from GetTool() dashboard command). Queried every 5 seconds automatically.

fields.data: int32 — active tool index (0-9). Index 0 = flange (no offset).

topics.description: Current robot operating mode from firmware. Published at 20Hz.
topics.notes: Unity should NOT send commands when mode != 5 (ENABLED). Show 'ERROR' UI if mode == 9.

topics.description: Robot error/alarm code from firmware feedback packet offset 1029.

fields.data: int32 — 0 = no error. Non-zero = alarm code. Robot is in error state.

topics.notes: When non-zero, show alert in Unity UI. Robot will not move.

topics.description: Bitmask of all 16 Digital Output ports on the robot. Bit N-1 = state of DO port N.

fields.data: int64 — bitmask. bit0 = DO1, bit1 = DO2, ..., bit15 = DO16

topics.description: Toggle vacuum suction cup. True = turn ON suction, False = turn OFF.

fields.data: bool — true: enable vacuum (DO1 ON), false: disable

topics.notes: ROS side has 2-second lockout after each command to wait for DO feedback to stabilize.

topics.description: Control signal lights on the robot base. Send [port, state] pair.
Collision haptic signal for Meta Quest 3 controller vibration. Sent when robot collision is detected.
topics.notes: Unity should trigger controller haptic on receipt. Signal is debounced on ROS side.

topics.description: Heartbeat from ROS to Unity. Sent every 1 second with Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
topics.notes: Used to verify ROS-Unity connection is alive and to measure clock offset.

topics.description: Heartbeat echo from Unity back to ROS. Send back the timestamp received from /teleop/ros_ping.

fields.data: string — echo of received ping timestamp as string, e.g. '1708820400123'

topics.notes: ROS uses this to calibrate clock offset between ROS and Unity for timestamp correction.

topics.description: Debug messages from ROS controller. Subscribe for diagnostic info in Unity console.
VR Dashboard command. Send one of the known command strings to control the robot state.

fields.data: string — one of the valid command keys (case-insensitive)

valid_commands.estop: EmergencyStop()— ⚠️ Immediate stop, all motion halted

topics.notes: Check /mg400/dashboard_response for acknowledgement. Use /mg400/robot_mode to confirm state change.

topics.description: Set global robot SpeedFactor (0–100%). Affects all motion commands. In VR, expose as a slider in the UI.
topics.notes: Default is 100%. Recommended range for real robot testing: 10–30% initially. Check /mg400/dashboard_response for ack.

topics.description: Acknowledgement feedback for /vr/dashboard_cmd and /vr/set_speed.

ros_launch.command: cd ~/project_teleop_ws && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run mg400_controller vr_teleop_node
